definitions: Roland Samuel Young (1887-1953) was an English-American actor and character actor. He began his acting career on the stage in London before moving to the United States, where he became known for his roles in films such as 'Topper' (1937) and 'The Philadelphia Story' (1940).
examples: Roland Samuel Young's portrayal of Cosmo Topper earned him an Academy Award nomination.
Many remember Roland Samuel Young for his distinctive voice and comedic timing.
The film featured Roland Samuel Young in a supporting but memorable role.
